prompt:
Bug report: with the `toc` extension, a heading like `# Hello world !` gets the id `hello-world-`, with a trailing dash. Fix it and add a regression test.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.

report.answer: `slugify` in the `toc` extension removed punctuation but kept the space that had been next to it, and that space became a dash. It now strips leading and trailing whitespace first, so `# Hello world !` gets the id `hello-world`, and `# ! Hello world` no longer gets a leading dash either. I added a regression test, which fails without the fix and passes with it, plus a changelog entry. The full suite passes: 1130 tests, 112 skipped. Only 2 of those skips are the PyYAML ones; the rest are optional tools that aren't installed (Pygments, Tidylib) or tests the project marks as excluded or known-broken.
